why.match: Matching by skills and time zone, not keywords.
why.salary: Candidates see your range with currency and taxes taken into account — fewer off-target applications.
why.both: Web3 and regular remote work in one place, in English and Russian.
why.trust: A verified badge builds trust and gets more replies.

trusted.title: Trusted
trusted.text: Granted automatically after steady activity without complaints.

limit.q: How many jobs can I post?

review.q: Why is my job under review?
review.a: The company is not verified yet or the post looks risky. Review usually takes up to a day.

contacts.q: When do I see a candidate's contacts?
contacts.a: After you mark the application as interesting: it moves to the shortlist and the contacts open.

salary.q: Can I leave the salary out?
salary.a: Yes, but such jobs rank lower in candidates' matches.

faq.title: Questions and answers
faq.q1: How do jobs get onto this {name} list?
faq.a1: Every published job that carries the {name} marker is here — the ones employers post with us and the ones we import from partner feeds, always with a link to the original. Nothing is placed for money.
faq.q2: Can I work remotely and keep my own hours?
faq.a2: Each card shows the work format, the employment type and the time zone the team needs you to overlap with, so you can see before you apply whether {name} work fits your day.
faq.q3: How do I follow new {name} jobs?
faq.a3: The RSS link at the top of this page carries the same list. Signed in, a saved search sends new matches by email or Telegram as they appear.

pricing.metaTitle: Pricing — free job search, paid speed
pricing.metaDescription: INTGETION pricing for companies and candidates. Posting jobs and searching stay free; paid plans add speed, reach and a refund if hiring does not work.
pricing.label: Pricing
pricing.title: Free for everything you need. Paid to go faster.
pricing.intro: Posting a job and finding one are free and stay free. Paid plans add reach, speed and tools — and the company plan comes with a refund if the candidates do not come.
pricing.soonNote: Paid plans are not on sale yet. Card and USDT / USDC payments are coming; until then everything on the free plans works.
pricing.market: Posting on the big remote boards costs $250–300 per job with no refund. Here it is free, or $79 with a guarantee.

alwaysFree.posting: Posting jobs — a free plan stays, with the same moderation and the same catalogue.
alwaysFree.trust: The verified-company badge and Trusted status are earned, not bought.
alwaysFree.contacts: Candidate contacts open only on mutual interest, on every plan.
alwaysFree.match: The match percentage and the order of «For you» are the same for everyone.
alwaysFree.apply: Candidates never pay to apply or to be seen.
alwaysFree.imported: Jobs imported from other boards are never promoted for money.

guarantee.q: What if the paid job gets fewer applications than promised?
guarantee.a: After 30 days we count applications from candidates who match at least 60%. If there are fewer than 10, the money goes back automatically — you do not need to ask.

cancel.a: Yes, in one click. A subscription works to the end of the paid period; there is no yearly lock-in.

crypto.a: Yes — USDT and USDC straight to the company wallet, prepaid for a period. Card payments go through Stripe.

seen.q: Will employers see that I pay?
seen.a: No. A candidate plan is never shown to employers — not in applications, not on the profile.

when.a: Paid plans are being prepared. Everything on the free plans works now.
